overclaims: A 2024 benchmark of several open and closed video models found that even the best one followed physical laws in under 40% of cases.
checks.note: The e3 explanation misstates the metric: 39.6% measures joint adherence to captions and physical laws, not adherence to physical laws alone. The rationale and agreed outcome otherwise match the qualified assessment.

overclaims: In February 2024, 14-year-old Sewell Setzer died by suicide right after a conversation with a Character.AI chatbot.
Futurism notes the Belgian account rests mostly on the widow's word.
checks.note: The supplied evidence establishes that Setzer died after the conversation, but does not establish 'right after.' The supplied Futurism text attributes the account to the widow and mentions chat logs; it does not state that the account rests mostly on her word. The reported-link qualification and agreed outcome are preserved.
